description: Ballarat Bridges is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. Point data for location of bridges in Ballarat. Included attributes ID, Site, Location, Feature Type, Centroid, Extents, Suburb, Ward, Area, Length, Width, Traffic Width Although all due care has been taken to ensure that these data are correct, no warranty is expressed or implied by the City of Ballarat in their use. Coverage: City of Ballarat. The portal files it under the publisher City of Ballarat. Its tags are ballarat, bridge, local government, transport. It offers 6 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, SHZ, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
